en: An old sepia-toned postcard showing a large Eastern Orthodox cathedral with multiple onion-shaped domes topped by crosses. The church has ornate neo-Byzantine / Russian Revival detailing, arched windows, and a prominent central dome with smaller side domes. To the left stands a stone obelisk monument on a pedestal, surrounded by short posts linked by chains. Low-rise European-style buildings frame the square in the background. The surface of the card is worn and stained, with faint handwritten marks near the top edge.
